source_manifest: 403 exact source Git blob hashes verified before compiling test
response_validation: wrk2 Lua response hook checks HTTP 200 and exact 64-byte body. The Java harness rejects detected non-success responses, socket errors, invalid-body diagnostics, and empty/NaN histograms. No deliberately wrong-response negative control has yet been executed.
limitations: Offered load was capped at 300 requests/s. Achieved throughput near 300 requests/s demonstrates load satisfaction at this rate, not saturation or maximum capacity. A virtualized shared GitHub-hosted runner on same-host loopback is unsuitable for official cross-runtime performance comparisons; results are not an official TechEmpower benchmark. JVM process stays alive across three trials.
